description: This file contains a custom Android Wear watch face service implementation using OpenGL ES 2.0 to render a 3D watch face with animated hands and tick marks. It extends Gles2WatchFaceService and defines an inner Engine class that manages OpenGL context creation, rendering, and camera movements, including handling ambient and interactive modes.

classes.name: OpenGLWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class extending Gles2WatchFaceService, responsible for creating the watch face engine.

classes.name: OpenGLWatchFaceService.Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending Gles2WatchFaceService.Engine, managing OpenGL setup, rendering, camera movement, and mode transitions.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the inner Engine class for rendering the watch face.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the watch face style and performs setup during Surface creation.

methods.name: onGlContextCreated
methods.description: Sets up OpenGL program objects, creates geometry for watch face ticks and hands, and precomputes camera and clock angles.

methods.name: onGlSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes the projection matrix based on surface aspect ratio and precomputes VP matrices for different camera positions.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Handles transition to and from ambient mode, invalidating the display for redraw.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Registers or unregisters the timezone receiver and triggers redraw.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Updates the display every system tick.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Performs OpenGL rendering of watch hands, ticks, and background, considering ambient or interactive mode.
